shared_elements: round-topped stele with arched upper field
human figures in profile facing one another
standing figure with arm raised in adoration/offering gesture
offering stand or altar between figures
hieroglyph-like inscription signs filling the upper field
pleated garments rendered by fine parallel incised lines
justification: Both are round-topped stelae bearing sunk-relief scenes of profile human figures in pleated garments facing an enthroned/large recipient figure, with an offering stand between them and columns of hieroglyph-like signs filling the space above and between, an unmistakably shared iconographic scheme. The main difference is that A shows a single upper scene with one seated and one adorant figure, while B divides its surface into two registers with several adorants in each.
